meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将脑影像数据整理为 BIDS 标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理神经科学影像数据并需要 BIDS 合规化
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroscience imaging data into BIDS standard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing neuroscience imaging data and need BIDS compliance

howto.what: 处理脑成像等神经科学数据时，Claude会按BIDS的固定规则帮你整理文件夹和文件名、写好配套说明文件；用PyBIDS按被试、任务等条件找出文件；用bids-validator检查规范；还指导把扫描仪DICOM数据转成BIDS。
howto.when: 当你要求整理脑成像、电生理等数据成BIDS格式，或查询、验证某个BIDS数据集，或把DICOM转成BIDS时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个DICOM文件夹转成BIDS格式。
say.note: 会指导你安装并使用HeuDiConv等转换工具。

say.text: 用PyBIDS查一下sub-01的所有task-rest的bold文件。
say.note: 返回该文件的路径和元数据。

say.text: 验证一下这个数据集是否符合BIDS规范。

howto.what_en: Claude will organize folders and filenames per BIDS rules, write metadata sidecars, query files by subject or task with PyBIDS, validate with bids-validator, and guide DICOM-to-BIDS conversion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to arrange imaging or electrophysiology data into BIDS, query or validate a BIDS dataset, or convert DICOM to BIDS.

say_en.text: Help me convert this DICOM folder into BIDS format.
say_en.note: Guides you through conversion tools like HeuDiConv.

say_en.text: Query all task-rest bold files for sub-01 using PyBIDS.
say_en.note: Returns the file paths and metadata.

say_en.text: Validate whether this dataset is BIDS-compliant.
say_en.note: Runs bids-validator and explains the report.
